description: A3 task 6 (F4): set logging in Round 7’s dialog (owner decision 1: a centred dialog with Close, rest running inside), with saved read-back and focus return (REQ-020; C46; JOURNEY-020, completion owner). check-01 proves the wiring on the real components and the real /workout route: /workout’s set, extra-set, correction, superset-round and circuit-movement entries are held by Round 7’s LoggingOverlay (src/ui/logging-overlay.tsx) through ExerciseSetLogger, SupersetRoundSheet, SupersetBlock and SetLoggingSheet; useSaveConfirmation (src/ui/set-save-confirmation.ts) confirms an accepted Log set N / Log round N only once the shell’s set list holds it — the saved result read back with its values, effort face and sync badge in role=status, a superset’s each ticked movement under its own name — beside the same running rest, never the next form; a refused save keeps its form; the rest ending (run out or skipped) closes the dialog and resets the confirmation, an early Close ends it, and only a deliberate Rest opens the next entry (AC-037: on the same running rest); an entry with no rest prescribed is confirmed and then closes itself once recorded; Save moves focus to the dialog title; focus returns to the card’s logging control (or a correction’s Edit for its X or Escape) only once the native dialog has closed; the Clear-set confirmation is drawn inside the dialog. The build’s LoggingOverlay cases are rewritten against Round 7’s dialog (TASK-016’s eight; TASK-019 focus kept inside, TASK-041 focus brackets, TASK-045 stale close carried unchanged); TASK-017 and TASK-018 cases are deferred to TASK-114 (see test-ledger.json). parity is the look check: each route this task wires beside its accepted gallery state (bec4454: anchor, other-lift, timed-movement, distance-movement, extra-set, set-correction, superset, circuit-movement) with matched data at 320 and 390 px — the card, the opened dialog and, for anchor and superset, the saved confirmation — compared in words and in layout (every element’s box within 2 px, each card’s top scrolled into view first); every visible difference must be labelled with the criterion that intends it; receipts in evidence/refinement/task-106/parity/, captures in the evidence store. The route journeys are e2e/refinement/task-020.spec.ts (TASK-020 check-02) and task-043.spec.ts (TASK-043 check-01), rewritten for Round 7 and run under their own manifests. Round 06 (A3, body clear-gallery-adoption-v2-20261118; owner decisions 2026-11-16, “Accept all five”): REQ-016 and REQ-019 (AC-R016-03, AC-C45-01, JOURNEY-016, JOURNEY-019) and the task-041 and task-019 suites are proved at TASK-114 and TASK-120, not here; this task keeps those behaviours for its own dialogs, so the carried cases that check them stay required in check-01 under this task’s own criteria (decision 1). Decision 5: with no rest prescribed, a save shows its confirmation and the dialog then closes itself; with a prescribed rest that already ended before Save, the confirmation stays until Close. src/ui/logging-overlay.test.tsx belongs to TASK-114 (owner decision 3, 2026-11-18); TASK-106 runs it whole because TASK-114’s cases do not exist yet, and adds only its own (TASK-016’s eight). Round 06 repair round 2 (2026-11-19): a close the consumer asked for is finished as the native dialog closes, not when the browser’s queued close event arrives; the added TASK-AC-C53DC0A896ED case reproduces that late event (task-043’s keyboard correction case had opened Log set 2 instead of Edit set 1).

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-106 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/logging-overlay.test.tsx src/ui/logging-overlay-focus-brackets.test.tsx src/ui/logging-overlay-focus-kept.test.tsx src/ui/logging-overlay-stale-close.test.tsx src/ui/set-logging-sheet.test.tsx src/app/sheet-minimize-access.test.tsx src/app/rest-footer-lifecycle.test.tsx src/app/superset-logging.test.tsx src/ui/set-correction.test.tsx src/ui/superset-block.test.tsx src/ui/set-logger.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false
